column3: (CSP form-action https: - the browser follows a sign-in form's redirect to the client's https return address and Chrome checks form-action on it; every form posts to this origin)
(continue in an attribute - escaped, and safeContinue allows only this issuer's own paths)
(no CSRF token - every form post is checked on Origin / Sec-Fetch-Site, cookies are SameSite=Lax; tested in auth.test.ts)
(a comment in passkey.js mentions autocomplete="username webauthn" - nothing secret)
(informational: pages and redirects are no-store on purpose - sign-in state and codes must never be cached)
(Permissions-Policy on passkey.js - the header only means something on a document; every page sends it)
(COOP and CORP are set on pages; no COEP - require-corp would block Turnstile's cross-origin frame, and nothing here needs cross-origin isolation)
(about ZAP's own requests lacking Sec-Fetch-* - browsers send them; form posts are checked on them)
(Base64 in favicon.svg - the kabouter icon embedded as a PNG data URL, nothing secret)
